study: Validation ranking stability and portfolio robustness on saved forecasts
history: 2022-2025 repeatedly inspected development; no confirmation claim
forecast_sources: Unchanged saved THINK+mixer AH+PM and restricted dynamic hypergraph final-checkpoint validation/test forecasts; all ten original seeds; no new neural fits or checkpoint changes
validation: Annual prior-year purged fold; assert last validation outcome precedes first test decision. Seed quality is mean per-date validation RankIC. Stable quality subtracts sample SD of four chronological quarter mean RankICs. NDCG@5/@10 and original/new group rank/top-five agreement are diagnostics.
weighting: Within each model family and fixed seed group: logits=clip((quality-mean(quality))/max(population_sd(quality),0.01),-2,2); weights=75% equal +25% softmax(logits). No seed exclusion. Family weights fixed 50:50. Equal method retains equal seed weights.
consensus: stable_consensus uses validation_stable seed weights, then subtracts 0.25 times weighted cross-model percentile-rank SD from the mean test score. No test outcomes used.
allocation: retain5/retain10 add fixed 0.02 to previous target's score before tie-aware equal selection. soft10 uses tie-aware top ten, weighted by exp(4*(score-max selected score)), normalized; no retention. Securities are not issuer-consolidated.
risk: Inherited 20-session basket volatility target20%; continuous short QQQ min(cap,1-long,20%/max(QQQ20-session annualized volatility,5%)); regular-close fills every five sessions using causal sizing and inherited costs
primary_goal: All three ensembles achieve base-cost Sharpe>=1.70. This tests comparable headline Sharpe with consistency, not merely a smaller gap from lower returns.
secondary_goal: Base-cost original-five SR>=1.50, new-five SR>=1.00, ten-seed SR>=1.3813185726078634, original/new absolute SR gap<=0.50
ranking: Report every recipe; order descriptive candidates by minimum original/new Sharpe, then ten-seed Sharpe. Disclose goals separately and never relabel a failed primary goal as success.
validation_reuse_limit: Saved checkpoints were chosen on MSE using this validation fold; postprocessing validation is not an independent checkpoint-selection sample. Test history is already spent. No validation-based epoch selection can be evaluated without new fits/per-epoch exports.
verification: Reproduce all18 matching equal/retain5 references, compare all216 signed-account daily paths with independent value-position replay, verify chronology and zero unavailable allocations, retain complete scores/weights/targets/paths/ledgers/calendar results; assess cross-group selection overlap and cost sensitivity
stop: One fixed216-account grid; no outcome-driven expansion, no2026returns, retraining, deployment or prospective-policy changes
